title: renderers/<id>.md header
description: A renderer's header. The JSON object between the --- lines only; the body is outside this schema. The body is its template, which reads only the piped value.

label.description: The display name of the renderer; never empty or whitespace.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the renderer).

input.description: The format the renderer accepts: a format name or an inline schema.

format.description: The text format of what the renderer returns: plaintext, markdown_block or markdown_inline.
